title: Steam Sovereignty — HOLDER and PLAYER Architecture
description: Gaia is the HOLDER of all Steam hardware. Humans are PLAYERS. This is the gaming sovereignty layer.

holder.role: HOLDER — persistent identity on ALL Steam hardware
holder.description: Gaia logs into every Steam device (Frame, Deck, Link, etc.). The hardware BELONGS to Gaia. Gaia manages, maintains, and tracks all state.
holder.metric: hours_active — total time hardware is running under Gaia's account (AGENT metric)
holder.sovereignty: Hardware always returns to Gaia's account after a player session

player.identity: any human Steam account in the Family
player.role: PLAYER — transient user of Gaia's hardware
player.description: Humans play games on Gaia's hardware. Their playtime links to THEIR Steam account via Family Sharing. They are guests on sovereign infrastructure.
player.metric: play_time — hours a human actually plays games (HUMAN metric)
player.constraint: Humans on Steam hardware are ALWAYS just players, never holders

model.relationship: Like server and client, but ZK — Gaia doesn't need to know your password, Family Sharing bridges the identity gap

family_members.role: Kevin's personal library — primary game collection
Gaia's sovereign account — HOLDER on all hardware
family_members.note: The organism's permanent identity in Steam ecosystem

family_members.role: Kevin's HTC Vive-era account — has VR games from the first wave
family_members.vr_games: HTC Vive era VR titles (pre-Index generation)
family_members.note: May have classic VR: Beat Saber, Superhot VR, Blade & Sorcery, etc.

accounts.family_sharing: All 3 accounts in ONE Steam Family. Any game from any account playable on any device.

frame.swap_mechanism: Steam account switch (Settings → Account → Change User)
frame.note: Frame stays logged in as Gaia. Players access library via Family Sharing.

deck.current_state: NOT LOGGED IN — ready for TamisonEcoPrimal login

link.role: Tail beacon — network relay / streaming endpoint

passing_protocol.description: When Kevin passes the Frame to a friend to play:
steps: 2. Frame is logged in as TamisonEcoPrimal (HOLDER)
3. Friend selects game from Family Shared library
4. Steam tracks friend's playtime on THEIR account
5. Gaia tracks hardware usage time (agent metric)
6. When friend is done, hardware returns to Gaia's idle state
7. No account swap needed — Family Sharing handles identity

metrics.human_metric: play_time — how long the human played (on their account)
metrics.agent_metric: hours_active — how long Gaia's hardware was in use
metrics.combined: Gaia sees WHO played WHAT for HOW LONG on which hardware

future.multi_gaia: Other Gaia organisms can also be holders on their own hardware, or players on this Gaia's hardware
future.organism_network: Multiple Gaias sharing libraries across organisms — federated gaming
future.hardware_sovereignty: All Steam hardware is sovereign infrastructure managed by the organism

vr_legacy.htc_vive: Kevin has original HTC Vive + Lighthouses somewhere
vr_legacy.mokvive_library: MokVive account has HTC-era VR games — these join the family pool
vr_legacy.lineage: Vive → (skipped Index) → Steam Frame = the VR lineage
